verifiedSourceFindings: The native Marketplace security register already owns retention policy records: angelcare_marketplace_security_retention_policies. It exposes domain, record_type, retention_days, legal_hold_supported, deletion_mode, archive_mode, territory_id, status, owner_role and review dates. The existing source route is a permission-gated read, not an erasure engine.
The native sensitive permission marketplace.security.retention.manage exists in its source migration. No new administration role or unrelated permission changes are needed merely to reuse it.

JOBKIX already owns authenticated privacy_export/privacy_deletion cases, versioned case replies/appeals and self-export. Actual retention/erasure fulfillment and hold records/commands are absent. No migration 029 has been authored.
Shared auth.users is the existing cross-product identity. Closing/removing JOBKIX data must not delete that identity or unrelated product records.

An account closure must consider active memberships, sole organization ownership and existing scoped read policies. Several self/support/history policies intentionally permit authenticated ownership reads independently of an active account; a status toggle alone does not prove complete erasure.

Applications, communication, interview/offer revisions, file references, cases, receipts, events and outbox records have separate retention and counterparty roles. A deletion request is currently a review request, not a proven confirmation to withdraw active recruitment or erase another party’s records.

Private document bytes use the existing service-authorized non-public JOBKIX bucket with immutable owner/file/original keys and hash verification. Physical purge requires durable guarded work and current hold/reference checks; archival is not erasure.
The inspected OpsOS storage destruction code governs its own storage domain. Its existence does not establish JOBKIX private-bucket or recruitment erasure authority.
nextImplementationRequirements: Bind reviewed JOBKIX retention decisions to actual native policy records; do not seed arbitrary periods or claim worldwide compliance.
Integrate purpose/audit/current-permission, exact-version/hash plan review and intended-user confirmation within existing case/account/admin components.
Add hold-aware bounded durable erasure/purge commands with shared identity and counterparty protections, storage acknowledgement/retry and explicit honest partial/retained states.
Execute isolated negative, concurrency/replay, hold/release, later-edit, private-byte purge and cross-product preservation checks before accepting the workflow.
